description:
Attached: 1 image

📢 The state of CSS survey 2025 results are out!
▶️ https://2025.stateofcss.com/

It showcases #developers’ favorite features—like ':has', container queries, and 'subgrid'—and notes their growing willingness to try out and adopt new features, supported by stronger standards and tooling. This shift is driven in part by greater awareness of initiatives like Baseline and the Interop project. Learn more: https://web-platform-dx.github.io/web-features/ and https://wpt.fyi/interop-2025
